thread:
sam: Heads up — nightly DAST run against staging is exploding with auth-related noise. ~45% of findings are 401/403s and the scanner can't fetch signed artifact URLs. I think the scanner service account lacks KMS decrypt on the signing key. Anyone touch scanner perms recently?

maria: I updated the scanner SA to a narrower IAM role last sprint (read-only storage + scan invocation) but explicitly did NOT add kms:Decrypt because of least privilege. I can add it but we need to ensure the grant is audited. We noticed last week's permission changes had missing audit entries. :thinking_face: 

lee: Also seeing a bunch of DAST open-redirect and health-check findings that are internal-only. Those should be suppressed or scoped away — they generate too much noise. Quick question: can the scanner be restricted to public routes only?

jonah: Repro steps I ran: 
```
# using scanner token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCANNER_TOKEN" "https://staging.redwood.internal/artifacts/123/signed" -v
# -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
# app logs: "KMSAccessDenied: cryptoKey decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
So it's definitely a kms:Decrypt missing. I also grep'd audit logs and the IAM binding change from last week lacks an AdminActivity entry (weird).

security-bot: Automated check: scanned IAM bindings for project redwood-staging -> scanner-sa missing roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. Flagging audit gap: recent grants missing `protoPayload.serviceData.policyDelta` entries. Suggested mitigation: add kms decrypt for scanner SA and add terraform-managed binding so changes are tracked.

maria: Proposed remediation steps: 
1) Immediate (manual): run `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/signer --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
2) Add Terraform change so binding is codified and peer-reviewed (PR -> eng-platform).
3) Add logging: ensure AdminActivity audit logging is enabled and alert on IAM grants to service accounts to avoid silent grants.

sam: +1. Also we should add a small auth-check in the scanner CI job: before running scans, attempt an authenticated fetch of a signed artifact and fail fast if 403. That will surface perms errors earlier.

lee: For the noisy findings: proposal — maintain a scanner allowlist file in repo `infra/scanner/allowlist.yaml` that the triage tool uses to auto-suppress findings on internal-only paths (e.g., /internal/health, /admin-debug). We can keep it minimal.

jonah: I'll prep the TF patch and a one-off manual gcloud command for an immediate hotfix. Assigning myself. I'll also add a small Cloud Logging alert rule for "IAMBindingChange" events that have resource.type=service_account.

maria: Minor gotcha — if we add kms:Decrypt to scanner-sa, make sure we scope it to the single key (not the whole project). Using the key-level binding like in step (1) above.

sam: Action items: 
- jonah: create PR with terraform binding + logging alert (owner) 
- maria: run manual gcloud binding for hotfix and paste command here when done 
- lee: add initial allowlist entries and a suppression rule in scanner config 
- sam: write short runbook for incident (SEC-487) describing how to triage scanner auth failures and audit gaps

jonah: starting manual fix now, will drop the command + audit link here when finished. :white_check_mark:

maria: manual bind executed and verified (role added to key). Here's the command I ran: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/signer \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Logs show AdminActivity entry at `https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query;resource=project/redwood-staging;cursor=...`

sam: Nice. jonah — once the TF PR is up, tag me and eng-platform. We'll also add a CI auth-check as a blocker for nightly runs. Closing loop after PR + allowlist merged. :eyes:

security-bot: Noted — creating an automated checklist item to run nightly IAM-binding audits and will post weekly summaries to #eng-security.

sam: thanks everyone — this prevented a missed vuln exception in last week's triage. We'll follow up in SEC-487 with postmortem and prevention steps.
